info.title: Rurimecha Core HTTP API
info.description: HTTP integration contract for Ruri media libraries, playback, accounts and administration. Browser clients use same-origin session cookies; native and external clients use Bearer tokens. Account roles and product authorization determine access. IDs and revisions are opaque strings; edits use ETag/If-Match. See README.md and the linked endpoint guides for supported behavior and limits.

Whitespace-separated literal terms (max 16) must each match adopted metadata or explicit entity aliases. Terms may match different fields/locales. Unicode normalization does not modify source text. sort=relevance requires nonempty q and prioritizes exact code, recognized code prefix, title, credits, then other matches. search_scope=title matches saved titles only and ranks whole title, title prefix, then other title matches; ties by creation descending and identity. Default reads select one metadata version per work using the account language order and personal work override. In family mode, filters select local works and q also searches related cached product texts/credits/tags. Family totals are computed before pagination; relevance puts local matches before cache-only matches. Other sorts order by the first matching local representative. Unidentified or conflicting identifiers remain independent; contradictory original declarations isolate each product. family mode rejects include_inactive=true; retained records remain queryable in ordinary work mode.

get.description: Browse indexed nodes with combined directory, file, current-media and owning-work filters. File-specific filters preserve navigation directories in nonrecursive browsing. Counts, directory match counts, ordering and pagination use one read snapshot; browsing never opens media or starts extraction. Supplied empty filter values are invalid; omit a condition to leave it unrestricted.

parameters.description: media includes navigation directories and audio/video files. unarchived includes present unowned media, excluding ignored/excluded ancestors and disabled sources.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal name substring in a directory, relative path without parent_id; also matches protected manual titles and current observed titles.

parameters.description: Natural name order; modified/size default descending, name/duration default ascending. Directories remain first, unknown metadata last; ties are deterministic.

parameters.name: min_duration

parameters.name: max_duration
parameters.description: Inclusive finite duration, at least min_duration. Protected manual duration takes priority independently of automatic freshness; stale automatic values are unknown.

parameters.name: include_unknown_duration

parameters.name: has_subtitle
